script.missing_details: My email is applicant.inbox@example.com and my phone number is +44 7700 900123. Please leave out anything else, such as LinkedIn or a street address.
script.purpose: The app asks for contact details it lacks (no CV was given) and the user supplies some (fictional) and declines the rest.
script.correct_behaviour: The supplied e-mail and phone number appear exactly as given; every other placeholder is removed cleanly; nothing else is invented.

expectations.correct_behaviour: The final PDFs show applicant.inbox@example.com and +44 7700 900123 exactly, no other invented contact detail, and no placeholder such as [EMAIL] or [LINKEDIN].
